newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia head urges rapid Stet sale.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia head urges rapid Stet sale.

text.p: The privatisation of Italian telecoms holding Stet should be carried out quickly, managing director of Telecom Italia Francesco Chirichigno said on Thursday.
"The privatisation must take place as soon as possible. It is necessary and fundamental not just for financial but also for industrial reasons," he told reporters.
The government hopes to sell off Stet by the end of next March but before the flotation can go ahead parliament must approve a bill setting up a watchdog authority for the sector.

The draft law has had a rough ride through parliament, changing shape a number of times. It is now tied to a contested bill proposed by Posts minister Antonio Maccanico covering new television ownership rules.
"We hope the Maccanico draft bill and the creation of an authority can be approved as soon as possible," Chirichigno said.

Stet managing director Ernesto Pascale warned earlier this month that unless the authority was approved by the end of November there would not be enough time to meet the flotation timetable. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
